items.html: And in the place of the aspect of the ears, the hairs of the Rosh are mentioned, which go out from the force of the ears, and from there is their root, and from there they spread. And therefore one must pass the hair from over the ears, as mentioned in the Idra of Naso, page 138, side B, and in the Tikkun 70, page 121, side A. And the reason for the matter, so that the judgments will not grip the ears greatly, and their force will not be strengthened in their root.
